PATTERN: Upload the full outfit photo ONCE to Playwright/Vinted → get one UUID → store on Search record → each item query uses shared UUID + item-specific catalogId + colorId + sizeId filters

WHY: Per-item crops were the problem — Gemini bbox is imprecise, small accessories (watch 43x32, belt 205x46) too small for CLIP, even clothing crops had wrong items included

HOW: identify route uploads full photo fire-and-forget → Prisma stores UUID on Search.imageSearchUUID → search route reads UUID per item, passes to vinted-image-search with filters

RESULT: Polo/pants/sneakers/bag all return visually relevant results. Watch/sunglasses/belt text-search-only (visual badge skipped for accessories)

GOTCHA: catalogId=5 is broad 'men's clothing' parent — covers polo AND pants, so catalog filter doesn't isolate clothing types precisely, but color/size/text still narrow results well
